description: Entered the two words and stopped the shoes.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Named the short hem, and hung the kirtle.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Kept today clear of the jig.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Placed the breath before the vowel, and stopped.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Asked if the dance was now, and agreed to wait.
name: Will Kemp

description: Refused the other bill, and went home.
name: William Shakespeare
